bank_name: South Bangla Agriculture & Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: SOLO/STANDALONE basis, unaudited. Balance sheet is the 31-March-2023 period-end snapshot (reported), compared against 31-December-2022 (audited). Income-statement items are for Q1 itself (01 Jan 2023 to 31 Mar 2023; cumulative and discrete are identical for Q1). PAT (131,772,992) and EPS (0.16) match EXACTLY the Q1-2023 comparative column independently printed in this bank's own 2024_Q1.json filing. Asset quality was stable and modest: classified loans (Note 8.11, Solo) Tk.4,170.33m (NPL 5.27%), barely above the 31-Dec-2022 comparative of Tk.4,031.22m -- both years well below the later FY2024/FY2025 deterioration. THIRD, EARLIEST regulatory-forbearance letter found in this bank's archive (predating the FY2024 and FY2025 letters already documented in this bank's other quarterly files): Note 8.10's own footnote states 'The Department of Off-site Supervision of Bangladesh Bank through letter reference no. DOS (CAMS)1157/41(dividend)/2023-2113 dated 25 April 2023, approved deferral against the deficit provision upto the finalization of financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2023.' The deferred shortfall itself was flat and modest across this period: Tk.370.00m at both 31-Dec-2022 and 31-Mar-2023 (this file), matching this bank's own FY2023 year-end figure of Tk.355.64m already recorded elsewhere in this dataset (2024_Q1.json's 31-Dec-2023 comparative) to within a small, presumably-provided-down amount. This establishes a THREE-YEAR RUN of annually-recurring Bangladesh Bank forbearance letters on this specific provision line (DOS(CAMS)1157/41(dividend)/2023-2113 for FY2023's ~Tk.370m gap; .../2024-1836 for FY2024's ~Tk.356m-then-exploding-to-Tk.6,558m gap; .../2025-3115 for the resulting Tk.11,430m gap by FY2024 finalization) -- see 2024_Q1/Q2/Q3.json and 2025_Q1/Q2/Q3.json for the escalating later chapters of this pattern. Capital adequacy (CRAR/RWA/Tier1/Tier2) disclosures are not part of this quarterly unaudited financial statement.
